_note: Server-side copy of the mobile app's assets/models/deploy_config.json verification threshold. submitAttendance prefers a Firestore config/model doc if present (so the threshold can change without redeploying functions), and falls back to this file. Keep BOTH in sync on every retrain — a mismatch means the app and server disagree about which model's embeddings are valid.
_threshold_note: 0.5508 is FAR-0.1% derived on 98 held-out identities (AUC 0.9915, EER 4.27%). Supersedes the v4 interim 0.70, which was fitted to only 2 people and belongs to a different embedding space. See assets/models/deploy_config.json training_provenance for the full eval, and issue.md for the operating-margin analysis (genuine mean 0.6279, only 0.077 above threshold).
_pilot_note: The palm layer is not a standalone gate — it is one layer alongside the Wi-Fi fingerprint and the staff-opened, palm-verified session window. Device binding is deliberately NOT enforced in this build. See README.md for the current scope statement (year-3 rollout) and honest limits of the Wi-Fi check.
